scope: Color contrast ratios on key elements
Form input labeling and associated labels
notes: Tested keyboard navigation through CPF input and Continue button. Filled form with test data (12345678900). Checked focus styles on CPF input which showed visible gold border and box-shadow. Examined all buttons, links, and form elements for proper labeling. Verified aria-required attribute on CPF input conflicted with required HTML attribute (aria-required='true' but required=false).

findings.description: The CPF input field exposes aria-required='true' but does not have the required HTML attribute set (required=false), creating a contradiction about whether the field is required. Assistive technologies receive conflicting information: the ARIA attribute indicates it is required, but the underlying HTML attribute indicates it is not. This violates WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 4.1.2 which requires that name, role, and state be correctly exposed to assistive technologies.
